input: root is absent or a finite acyclic binary tree with n distinct ordinary mutable nodes and no shared child. Each has safe-integer val and writable left/right data fields, holding a child or None/null. limit and every original root-to-node prefix sum are safe integers. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt; separately declared probabilities are finite primitive Number.
return: Original root with exactly nodes that lie on at least one original root-to-leaf path of total at least limit retained, or None/null if no such path exists. A formerly internal node does not become a valid terminal path merely because its children were pruned.
mutation_aliasing: Intentionally prunes original child links in place. Node identities and values stay unchanged; detached objects still exist for caller aliases, which observe any prior child pruning. Returning absent does not modify the caller variable. No new nodes are allocated; the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Every prefix sum, not merely final leaf sums, must fit the shared exact safe-integer domain. Original-leaf flags are captured before descendants are processed, preserving the original path definition even with negative values. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n + 1) time and O(h + 1) auxiliary space for original height h. The iterative postorder stack retains a constant-size record per active ancestor and pending sibling, with each node expanded once. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1145 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper definition, Solution wrapper, signatures, loops, built-in calls, comments/annotations, whitespace and terminal newline.
